review_limits_and_followups: This wrapper review does not substitute for the separately sealed/helper-reviewed packet pins supplied at launch, nor for the actual-input admission and post-execution receipt acceptance.

Capture records actual systemd CPU/memory/swap/runtime properties; final result acceptance should compare these captured values with the admitted limits because capture_status PASS_METADATA_ONLY currently gates terminal success and receipt schema but does not itself reject a property mismatch.

The prior F3 stage1 root wrapper pair is frozen V1 and was not modified in this review. Root has identified a separate V2 hardening follow-up for its direct-child cgroup accounting before any future F3 stage1 wrapper reuse.
reviewed_controls: Launcher requires the exact helper preparation-manifest and independent-review hashes as CLI inputs, verifies every artifact hash in the manifest, and checks the review PASS/blocker fields and manifest binding.

Launcher binds to the pinned fresh ROOT_PATH_PREFLIGHT receipt and freshly hashes the eight allowlisted inputs with stable lstat generation checks, exact sizes, no symlink resolution, and an exact total byte count before producing a root admission record.

Launcher checks create-only remote receipt/stage/unit names and all local output paths before SSH; transport and returned raw records use exclusive creation. Remote staging is an exact three-helper plus input-manifest allowlist, with helper bytes rehashed after staging.

Fresh resource admission requires the current exact F3 sequence/worker, an empty campaign-slice cgroup.procs, every populated direct child to be one of the expected bounded units, exact child CPU/memory/swap caps, total CPU at most 2 cores including the 0.5-core support unit, committed memory below 17 GB, physical scratch, and at least 2 GB free disk.
The unit command sets CPUQuota=50%, MemoryMax=1.5 GB, swap=0, RuntimeMax=120 seconds, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, thread limits, and the approved scratch directory.

Capture refuses local output collisions before SSH, waits for an exited/failed terminal state, captures raw receipt bytes and hashes before stopping the owned unit, validates terminal status and metadata-only receipt schema fields, writes execution/stop evidence create-only, and returns failure on acceptance errors.
scope: Independent static review only. No remote calls, helper execution, checkpoint/array reads, training, or inference were performed.
